result.instructions: Tools for Webfleet, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Where are our vehicles right now?"; "Which trips did vehicle 12 drive yesterday?"; "Which vehicles are nearest to this customer address?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Webfleet data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run webfleet_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run webfleet_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run webfleet_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. webfleet_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: webfleet_list_object_groups
tools.title: List object groups
tools.description: List the object groups (vehicle groups) of the account, with the number of objects in each group. Webfleet limit: 10 requests per minute.

objectgroupuid.description: Object group id (objectgroupuid), as Webfleet returns it.

tools.name: webfleet_list_objects
tools.title: List objects with last position
tools.description: List the objects (vehicles, trailers, assets) of the account with their master data and last known position, in WGS84 micro degrees (latitude_mdeg, longitude_mdeg). Webfleet limit: 6 requests per minute.

filterstring.description: Text that must appear in the object data.

ungroupedonly.description: true: only objects that are in no group.

objectno.description: Object number (the vehicle or asset number in Webfleet).

objectuid.description: Unique object id (objectuid), as Webfleet returns it.

tools.name: webfleet_get_vehicle
tools.title: Get vehicle details
tools.description: Get the vehicle master data of one or more objects: registration, type, dimensions, fuel type, speed limit, description and the telematics device ids. Give objectno, objectuid, objectgroupname or filterstring. Webfleet limit: 6 requests per minute.

objectno.description: Object number (the vehicle or asset number in Webfleet).

objectuid.description: Unique object id (objectuid), as Webfleet returns it.

filterstring.description: Text that must appear in the object data.

tools.name: webfleet_find_nearest_vehicles
tools.title: Find nearest vehicles
tools.description: Find the 8 nearest vehicles to a place, with the routed distance and time. Give addrno (an address of the account) or latitude and longitude. Webfleet limit: 10 requests per minute.

addrno.description: Address number of an address in the account.

tools.name: webfleet_list_drivers
tools.title: List drivers
tools.description: List the active drivers of the account with their driver number and contact data. Webfleet limit: 10 requests per minute.

filterstring.description: Text that must appear in the object data.

driveruid.description: Driver id (driveruid), as Webfleet returns it.

ungroupedonly.description: true: only drivers that are in no group.

tools.name: webfleet_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the orders (jobs) of the account or of one object, with state, destination, contact and assigned driver. Webfleet limit: 6 requests per minute.

objectno.description: Object number (the vehicle or asset number in Webfleet).

objectuid.description: Unique object id (objectuid), as Webfleet returns it.

tools.name: webfleet_list_addresses
tools.title: List addresses
tools.description: List the addresses of the account (address book) with name, location in WGS84 micro degrees and contact data. Webfleet limit: 6 requests per minute.

filterstring.description: Text that must appear in the object data.

addruid.description: Address id (addruid), as Webfleet returns it.

tools.name: webfleet_list_trips
tools.title: List trips
tools.description: List the trips of the account in a relative date range (the filter uses the trip end time), or all trips after a tripid for continuous replication. Max 10000 entries per reply. Webfleet limit: 1 request per minute.

objectno.description: Object number (the vehicle or asset number in Webfleet).

objectuid.description: Unique object id (objectuid), as Webfleet returns it.

tripid.description: Return trips after this tripid. Pass the highest tripid of the last reply.

range_pattern.description: Relative date range, for example d-1 (yesterday, the default), d0 (today), w0 (this week), m-1 (last month).

tools.name: webfleet_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the events (alarms and messages) of the account in a relative date range, optionally for one object, with their acknowledged and resolved state. Webfleet limit: 1 request per minute.

objectno.description: Object number (the vehicle or asset number in Webfleet).

objectuid.description: Unique object id (objectuid), as Webfleet returns it.

acknowledged.description: true: only acknowledged events. false: only events not acknowledged.

resolved.description: true: only resolved events. false: only events not resolved.

range_pattern.description: Relative date range, for example d-1 (yesterday, the default), d0 (today), w0 (this week), m-1 (last month).

tools.name: webfleet_create_address
tools.title: Create address
tools.description: Create one address in the account's address book. Give a unique address number and a name. Coordinates are WGS84 decimal degrees; give both or neither. Creates a new record; it does not change or delete one. Webfleet limit: 900 requests per hour.

addrnr.description: Unique address number of the new address (addrnr).

prompts.title: Get started with Webfleet
prompts.description: What you can do with Webfleet here, with example requests to try.
